<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_INQ_IP" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TransactionDataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DataTransmission" name="Transmission of data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ" processRef="Process_INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Data" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="Event_DataReceived" messageRef="Message_DataTransmission"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Event_RejectionReceived" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_INQ" name="Request to be transmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitRequest" name="Transmit transaction data request" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAnswer" name="Wait for IP answer" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DataReceived" name="Receive transmission of data">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DataReceived" messageRef="Message_DataTransmission"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RejectionReceived" name="Receive rejection">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RejectionReceived" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataReceived" name="Data received"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionReceived" name="Rejection received"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_INQ" targetRef="Task_TransmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAnswer" targetRef="Event_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAnswer" targetRef="Event_RejectionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_5" sourceRef="Event_DataReceived" targetRef="EndEvent_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_6" sourceRef="Event_RejectionReceived" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check INQ request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" name="Examination outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TransmitData" name="Transmit data" messageRef="Message_DataTransmission"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RejectionSent" name="Rejection sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_3" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_TransmitData">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">outcome = 'transmission of data'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_4" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">outcome = 'rejection'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_5" sourceRef="Task_TransmitData" targetRef="EndEvent_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_6" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_RejectionSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
